description: Multiple defense evasion actions by the same actor within 10 minutes — disabling CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Config, or Security Hub in sequence.
playbook: This is a strong indicator of an active intrusion. The actor is systematically disabling logging and detection. Disable the actor immediately, re-enable all affected services, and initiate a full incident response. Assume all activity since the first evasion action may be unlogged.
